item.gachawaifus.gacha_terminal.desc: Right-click: opens the GACHA screen with both banners — the FEATURED one (Pink Balls) and the PERMANENT one (Blue Balls). Pull x1 or x10 inside and see your pity, guarantee and balls at a glance. Shift + right-click: instant x10 of the featured banner. 5-star pity: 1.6% base, rises from pull 51, guaranteed at 64. 4-star rank: 10% with its own pity (guaranteed at 32). 15% double pull. The featured waifu rotates each Minecraft day; check it with /banner.
item.gachawaifus.pink_ball.desc: One Gacha pull. Crafted with a diamond in the centre and copper, lapis lazuli, iron and coal in a cross. You also get one free every day (on login, or with /pull). Spend it at the Gacha Terminal or the Gacha Machine. /banner shows the featured waifu and your pity.
item.gachawaifus.blue_ball.desc: A pull for the permanent banner. Crafted with an iron ingot in the centre and lapis lazuli in a cross (1 iron + 4 lapis → 1 ball). Spend it on the PERMANENT tab of the Gacha Terminal.
item.gachawaifus.waifu_capsule.desc: Right-click: opens your collection. Shift + right-click your waifu: stores her. Click an entry: summons her. If a waifu falls in battle her soul stays in the capsule, and you revive her there with 4 diamonds.

gachawaifus.guide.p1.l4: §fThis mod fills your world with waifus from Zenless
gachawaifus.guide.p1.l5: §fZone Zero, Honkai, Genshin and several more anime.
gachawaifus.guide.p1.l6: §fThey are tameable pets: they follow you, fight at your
gachawaifus.guide.p1.l7: §fside and can stand guard at your base.
gachawaifus.guide.p1.l13: §f· The scroll wheel or a click on the sheet turns pages.
gachawaifus.guide.p2.l3: §a1 §f§dGACHA §f— craft balls and pull at the
gachawaifus.guide.p2.l4: §f   Terminal or the Machine. That's the route to
gachawaifus.guide.p2.l8: §a3 §f§aTAMING §f— they spawn wild in the biomes
gachawaifus.guide.p2.l9: §f   and are tamed with balls of hits. Page 9.
gachawaifus.guide.p3.l7: §f· Each one gives one attempt at the day's §f5★§f.
gachawaifus.guide.p3.l12: §f· Gives one attempt of the §f7 §fclassics pool.
gachawaifus.guide.p3.l13: §f· Craftable at any table: no furnace or
gachawaifus.guide.p4.l4: §f· Craft: three amethyst blocks on top,
gachawaifus.guide.p4.l5: §f  diamond in the center, cobblestone below.
gachawaifus.guide.p4.l6: §f· §fClick §f— opens the screen with both tabs:
gachawaifus.guide.p4.l8: §f  the guarantee and the balls you carry.
gachawaifus.guide.p4.l9: §f· §fShift + click §f— instant x10 of the promotional,
gachawaifus.guide.p4.l13: §f· The block placed in the world: same draw,
gachawaifus.guide.p5.l5: §f· §eSoft pity§f: from pull §f51 §fit rises a further
gachawaifus.guide.p5.l7: §f· §cHard pity§f: on pull §f64 §fshe is yours for sure.
gachawaifus.guide.p5.l8: §f· When one drops there is a §f50 % §fchance it is the
gachawaifus.guide.p5.l9: §f  featured one. If you lose, you take a waifu
gachawaifus.guide.p5.l13: §f· The pity counter shows on the Terminal screen,
gachawaifus.guide.p6.l6: §f· The featured banner waifu rotates every Minecraft
gachawaifus.guide.p6.l10: §f· No 50 %: direct delivery of one of the §f7
gachawaifus.guide.p6.l12: §f· Its pity (§f64§f) runs apart from the promotional.
gachawaifus.guide.p6.l13: §f· Misses are not empty: they give §6food§f.
gachawaifus.guide.p6.l14: §f· The cheapest route: only lapis and iron.
gachawaifus.guide.p7.l3: §fA token summons its waifu at the block you
gachawaifus.guide.p7.l4: §flook at: right-click the ground. If you already
gachawaifus.guide.p7.l5: §fhave her summoned within §f128 §fblocks, it does nothing.
gachawaifus.guide.p7.l14: §f· Their eggs are in the creative tab.
gachawaifus.guide.p8.l6: §f· Paid with balls, tokens and food.
gachawaifus.guide.p8.l7: §f· They rotate with the Minecraft day.
gachawaifus.guide.p8.l12: §f· With a cap, tokens and the capsule stop
gachawaifus.guide.p8.l13: §f  summoning: store one with Shift + click
gachawaifus.guide.p8.l14: §f  on her and free the slot (page 10).
gachawaifus.guide.p9.l3: §fOwnerless waifus roam the world, each biome
gachawaifus.guide.p9.l4: §fwith its own list. Tame them by clicking §cPink Balls
gachawaifus.guide.p9.l9: §f  More expensive than the gacha, but the wild one
gachawaifus.guide.p9.l10: §f  waits still: the counter never resets.
gachawaifus.guide.p9.l11: §f· §eTame pity§f: at attempt §f128 §fshe is tamed for sure.
gachawaifus.guide.p9.l12: §f· The ones you already own don't tame: the attempt
gachawaifus.guide.p9.l14: §f· §a/biomes §fsays what spawns in your current biome.
gachawaifus.guide.p10.l5: §f· §fClick §f— opens your collection: all the ones you
gachawaifus.guide.p10.l7: §f· §fShift + click on your waifu §f— stores her.
gachawaifus.guide.p10.l8: §f  She despawns safely, without dying on the way.
gachawaifus.guide.p10.l9: §f· Click an entry of the collection: she is
gachawaifus.guide.p10.l13: §f· If a waifu falls in combat, her soul stays in the
gachawaifus.guide.p10.l14: §f  capsule: revive her there with §a4 diamonds§f.
gachawaifus.guide.p11.l3: §fShift + right click §fwith an §fEMPTY HAND §fon one of
gachawaifus.guide.p11.l4: §fyours opens the mode panel: five buttons, the
gachawaifus.guide.p11.l5: §factive one marked and her home written at the foot.
gachawaifus.guide.p11.l9: §e· NEUTRO §f— defends only: goes at whatever hits
gachawaifus.guide.p11.l12: §9· SENTADA §f— still: doesn't follow you, doesn't roam,
gachawaifus.guide.p11.l13: §f  doesn't cross dimensions and doesn't attack.
gachawaifus.guide.p12.l9: §f· It is the anchor of the §2En casa §fmode: there she guards
gachawaifus.guide.p12.l10: §f  and bites anything that comes close.
gachawaifus.guide.p12.l11: §f· §fBreaking it §ftakes their home away and warns you.
gachawaifus.guide.p12.l13: §f· §fClick §f— brings §fall §fto your side, even from another
gachawaifus.guide.p13.l3: §fVanilla fails in three cases, and all three are
gachawaifus.guide.p13.l4: §f"my waifu got lost": owner in §fanother dimension
gachawaifus.guide.p13.l5: §f(she can't see you), §fno path §f(stuck in her base) and
gachawaifus.guide.p13.l10: §f  dimension. If one is very far from her destination
gachawaifus.guide.p13.l11: §f  §fand still §ftwo checks in a row, it brings her to your
gachawaifus.guide.p13.l12: §f  side (or sends her home if she is in §2En casa §fmode)
gachawaifus.guide.p13.l13: §f  and tells you in the action bar.
gachawaifus.guide.p13.l14: §f· One still walking toward you is not pulled.
gachawaifus.guide.p14.l3: §fEverything is tuned in §fMods menu → Gacha Waifus →
gachawaifus.guide.p14.l11: §f· §fwild §f— spawn chance, check interval, max nearby
gachawaifus.guide.p14.l12: §f  and taming odds of wild waifus.
gachawaifus.guide.p14.l13: §f· It is a §fCOMMON §fconfig: the dedicated server
gachawaifus.guide.p14.l14: §f  reads it too and all players share it.
gachawaifus.guide.p15.l3: §fEvery waifu has a color, and the color is the tag:
gachawaifus.guide.p15.l4: §fthey are not elements, they are the mod's classes.
gachawaifus.guide.p15.l12: §f  colors. The mod applies the matrix on its own.
gachawaifus.guide.p15.l13: §f· Every token shows its color in its tooltip.
gachawaifus.guide.p16.l10: §a/here §f— where yours are and their dimension.
